summary.text: Matt LaMountain is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 31 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
An attorney, he has served in the Senate since January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Matthew LaMountain lives in Warwick, Rhode Island, and graduated from Mount Saint Charles Academy in 2003.
He earned a B.A. in the administration of justice from Salve Regina University in 2007 and a J.D. from Suffolk University Law School in 2010.
His career experience includes working as a prosecutor in the Rhode Island attorney general's office, as assistant city solicitor for the City of Warwick, and as an attorney in his own practice.
LaMountain assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 3, 2023, and his current term ends on January 5, 2027.

For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Environment and Agriculture Committee and a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee and the Rules, Government Ethics and Oversight Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
